title: Epworth Sleepiness Scale
description: 8 everyday situations, each rated 0–3 for the chance of dozing.

holder.name: Murray W. Johns (licensed through Mapi Research Trust)

citation.text: Johns MW (1991). A new method for measuring daytime sleepiness: the Epworth sleepiness scale. Sleep 14(6):540–545.

scoring.text: Sum of the 8 items (0–24); above 10 suggests excessive daytime sleepiness. Scoring here follows the published literature; check it against the manual or form your lab holds before publishing.
